verdict.rationale: Databricks documents first-party MCP client support. Agents on the platform get governed access to tools through built-in system.ai MCP Services and external MCP servers you register. Agent code can discover, authenticate to, and call managed, MCP Service, and custom MCP servers, and the Marketplace lists MCP servers for discovery. Missing for 10: no evidence that the built-in Genie Code assistant itself can consume registered MCP servers without custom agent code, no detailed registration/configuration docs in the pack, and no independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Give your agent governed access to third-party and SaaS tools such as Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Google Calendar, and Gmail — through built-in system.ai MCP Services, external MCP servers you register
Discover, authenticate to, and call managed, MCP Service, and custom MCP servers from your agent code, then deploy the agent on Databricks Apps.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets your agent query data, search documents, and call external services.
Listings include datasets, AI models, notebooks, apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
